visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white stand mixer is seen from a close-up angle, its hook kneading a pale dough inside a stainless steel bowl under bright indoor lighting. (2) Olive oil is poured from a green glass bottle into a clear rectangular plastic container on a marble countertop. (3) A woman's hand, wearing no jewelry, spreads the oil with a spatula, then presses a large piece of dough into the container before snapping a blue-rimmed lid shut. (4) The woman, dressed in a yellow striped shirt, uses a brown plastic scraper to divide a long piece of dough into smaller portions on the marble surface. (5) Close-up of hands rolling the small dough portions into smooth balls. (6) On a wooden cutting board, a knife slices through a piece of cooked smoked chicken. (7) A marble rolling pin is used to flatten a dough ball; cheese and chicken bits are then placed inside, and the dough is folded and rolled into a bagel shape. (8) The bagels are placed into a white Sharp Healsio steam oven; the woman turns a dial and presses buttons on the digital interface. (9) Bagels are dropped into a pot of simmering water on an induction cooktop, then flipped with a spatula. (10) The golden-brown bagels are removed from the oven and transferred to a wire cooling rack using a metal spatula.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 女兒開學第四週. (2) [Subtitle]: 繼續幫她準備早餐帶去宿舍. [Subtitle]: 今天做燻雞起司BAGEL. (3) [Subtitle]: 用「冷藏發酵」分段做更輕鬆. [Variety]: Yum! Yum! (4) [Subtitle]: 開學快一個月了. [Subtitle]: 我「你適應的怎麼樣？」. (5) [Subtitle]: 女兒「大學沒有你說的那麽好玩」. (6) [Subtitle]: 我說「才一個月，再給一點時間吧」. (7) [Subtitle]: 她可能睡不習慣吧，假日她都會回家. [Subtitle]: 如果她適應不好，難免會擔心她受挫. [Subtitle]: 如果適應太好，是不是就不常回家了？. (8) [Subtitle]: 當個媽媽，心裡面的情緒太多了. [Subtitle]: 有時候覺得下輩子當男人好了. [Subtitle]: 當女人真的蠻辛苦的（情緒好多）. (9) [Subtitle]: 但這輩子也只能這樣囉. [Subtitle]: 繼續做麵包烤麵包，聞著香氣，看家人吃的開心. [Subtitle]: 就暫時忘掉這些煩惱了. (10) [Slogan]: 食譜在留言區.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video demonstrates how to make smoked chicken and cheese bagels using a cold fermentation method. Beyond the recipe, the creator shares a personal reflection on motherhood, specifically her feelings and dialogue with her daughter who has recently started university.
